decision.name: v1 core readiness / release scope lock
decision.purpose: Lock the v1 Store release feature set and define entry criteria for privacy, deletion, and consent implementation.

v1Included: Listen with normal model audio generation or cache reuse
Record with microphone or supported upload path
Evaluate with OpenAI transcription and Azure pronunciation evaluation
Review with persisted score, transcript, weak words, coach next step, and saved result playback
Progress with latest result, best result, saved best take and saved model audio summaries
Normal model audio generation through server-side provider boundary
Settings, support, privacy / terms draft routes, and account deletion request / dry-run / proof planning surfaces
Provider readiness for OpenAI, Azure, ElevenLabs normal voice path, Supabase, and Vercel
Store release operations and release QA
v1Excluded: Brush-up generated audio candidate creation or acceptance
Brush-up-specific quota, cost, latency, and retry proof
Any Store metadata or privacy copy that claims Brush-up is available in v1
v1_1Scope: Script-scoped voice material or voice variant design and implementation
Brush-up explicit consent and revoke UX
Brush-up generated audio candidates and app-owned replay proof
Brush-up-specific provider cleanup, retention, and deletion proof
Brush-up cost, latency, and retry proof

providerWarnClassification.item: Brush-up cleanup / retention / script-scoped feasibility / cost-latency-retry
Protected replay not confirmed in this pass

v1ReleaseBlockers: Provider kill switch readiness for OpenAI, Azure, ElevenLabs normal voice, and Storage uploads
Azure alert or accepted manual monitoring owner
Actual account/data deletion completion path for the v1 feature set
Disposable deletion proof for actual v1 data and provider resources
Final Privacy Policy, Terms, support, and deletion request copy matching v1 without Brush-up
App Privacy and Google Data Safety answers matching actual v1 behavior
Support URL and privacy policy URL
Release QA for Web core, mobile browser or future WebView audio path, protected replay, auth/session, provider failure recovery, account deletion, support, and monitoring
v1NonBlockersOrReleaseQa: OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL explicit env presence if default is accepted
Supabase protected replay proof for normal v1 audio
Brush-up-specific cleanup, retention, script-scoped feasibility, revoke, and account deletion proof
privacyDeletionConsentEntryCriteria: v1 does not include Brush-up and does not send a best take to a provider as script-scoped voice material.
Recording consent covers normal practice recording upload, transcription, pronunciation evaluation, review, replay, and progress only.
AI provider explanation covers OpenAI transcription / Script Studio generation, Azure pronunciation evaluation, ElevenLabs normal voice generation, Supabase storage/auth/DB, and Vercel hosting.
Voice sample and consent recording copy covers normal voice setup and normal model audio generation only.
Account deletion scope covers actual v1 data and provider resources, excluding Brush-up-specific artifacts.
Storage cleanup proof covers v1 buckets and does not depend on Brush-up material buckets or rows.
Provider cleanup proof covers normal cloned voices / provider resources used by v1, not Brush-up variants.
Support URL, privacy policy URL, deletion request path, and reviewer instructions do not promise Brush-up.
Remaining Gate 3 WARN accepted for v1 is documented with an owner, mitigation, and Gate 6 verification point.
notes: No code, DB, provider, env, infra, or dashboard changes were made.
No secrets, env values, raw provider responses, transcript body, private audio paths, provider identifiers, or billing details are recorded.
